content.content:
=== V4__invoices.sql ===
-- Invoices: money billed on a project. Each invoice belongs to exactly one project (project_id FK).
-- Additive: a new versioned migration alongside the clients and projects tables.
CREATE TABLE invoices (
    id         BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    amount     NUMERIC(19, 2) NOT NULL
);
=== V5__invoices_status.sql ===
-- Invoices carry a payment status (default UNPAID). Marking an invoice paid flips this to PAID.
-- Additive: a new versioned migration alongside the existing invoices table.
ALTER TABLE invoices ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNPAID';
=== V8__invoices_status_draft_default.sql ===
-- Invoices move through a lifecycle: DRAFT (default for a new invoice) -> SENT -> PAID.
-- Additive: a new versioned migration that switches the default status from UNPAID to DRAFT.
ALTER TABLE invoices ALTER COLUMN status SET DEFAULT 'DRAFT';
=== V13__invoices_amount_derived.sql ===
-- An invoice's amount is now derived from its line items (the sum of qty * unit_price), not typed
-- in directly. Relax the stored amount column so an invoice can exist before it has any line items
-- (a total of zero): default it to 0 and drop the positive-amount check. Additive: a new versioned
-- migration alongside the existing invoices table.
ALTER TABLE invoices ALTER COLUMN amount SET DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE invoices DROP CONSTRAINT invoices_amount_positive;
=== V18__payments.sql ===
-- Payments: money a client has paid against an invoice. Each payment belongs to exactly one invoice
-- (invoice_id FK) and records how much was paid (amount) and when (paid_date). An invoice can have
-- many payments. Additive: a new versioned migration alongside the existing invoices table.
CREATE TABLE payments (
    id         BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices(id),
    amount     NUMERIC(19, 2) NOT NULL,
    paid_date  DATE NOT NULL
);

content.text: Now the database migration. Since paid-ness is now derived from payments, I'll add a forward-only migration that normalizes the stored lifecycle column (which no longer owns paid-ness):

input.content:
-- An invoice's paid state is now worked out from the payments recorded against it (PARTIAL once
-- some of the amount is paid, PAID once it is covered), not flipped by hand. The stored status
-- column therefore only owns the issued lifecycle: DRAFT (not sent) vs SENT (sent). Normalise any
-- rows still carrying the old hand-set 'PAID' back to 'SENT' (they were issued) so the stored
-- column no longer contradicts the derived status. Additive: a new versioned migration alongside
-- the existing invoices table.
UPDATE invoices SET status = 'SENT' WHERE status = 'PAID';

## Summary

I implemented a full-stack change so an invoice's status is **worked out from recorded payments** rather than flipped to paid by hand.

**Server (derivation is the core of the change):**
- `InvoiceRepository.java` — added a `DERIVED_STATUS` SQL expression used by every invoice query: `DRAFT` while unsent, then `SENT` (issued, unpaid), `PARTIAL` (some paid), `PAID` (payments cover the amount). Status is computed at read time from the `payments` table, so it always reflects what's recorded.
- `PaymentsPostLogic.java` — recording a payment now writes the audit line `PAYMENT_RECORDED id=<id> amount=<amount>` via the `Audit` service.
- New `InvoiceGetLogic` + `invoices/get.GET.yml` — a single-invoice GET so the detail view can read the derived status after a payment (additive: one new logic class + one new YAML under `rest/api/`).

**Database:**
- `V19__invoices_status_derived_from_payments.sql` — forward-only migration normalizing any legacy hand-set `PAID` rows back to `SENT`, since the stored column now only owns the issued lifecycle (DRAFT/SENT) and paid-ness is derived.

**Front-end:**
- `InvoiceDetail.tsx` — fetches and displays the derived status (`data-testid="invoice-status"`), refreshing it after each payment is recorded.
- `ProjectInvoices.tsx` — removed the manual "Mark paid" button (the flip-by-hand action the request asked to retire); the existing row `invoice-status` now shows the derived value.

The `invoices/pay` endpoint remains but is no longer reachable from the UI, keeping the change local and additive. The Playwright spec passes (SENT → PARTIAL after $40 → PAID after $60, with the expected audit line).
